newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's Daewoo shelves Lotus takeover plan.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's Daewoo shelves Lotus takeover plan.

text.p: South Korea's Daewoo Motor Co Ltd, a unit of Daewoo Group, has shelved plans to buy a major stake in Britain's Group Lotus Ltd, a Daewoo Motor spokesman said.
"We have not talked to Lotus for several months over any acquisition," spokesman Lee Chang-won told Reuters. "We had earlier sought to take over the company but the idea has been shelved."
Lotus said on Tuesday it would give details of its plans for a new partner and for the future at a news conference on Wednesday.
Lotus's Italian owner Romano Artioli has been seeking a new partner to take up a stake in the automotive engineer and sports car maker for much of this year.
Lee said Daewoo was not ruling out future talks if a compromise was reached. "Our previous negotiations could not narrow differences," he said.
Daewoo and Malaysia's Proton are seen as the top contenders as a partner for Lotus.
